abilities.effect: If the target does not have the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.

abilities.name: THE BANNER OF SCREAMING FLESH
abilities.effect:
This unit has the PLEDGED TO SLAANESH keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: ALL THE RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the coveted pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.

abilities.name: HATRED FOR ALL
abilities.declare: You must use this ability if this unit is not in combat and there are any other visible friendly units within this unit’s combat range. You must pick 1 of those friendly units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks for this unit against the target.

abilities.name: SKARBRAND’S RAGE
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, or if it did not use a FIGHT ability last turn, the effects of the ’Blood-drenched’ ability apply to this unit.

abilities.name: INESCAPABLE WRATH
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: ROAR OF TOTAL RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of damage points this unit has. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: EVERYONE ABOARD!
abilities.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly INFANTRY HERO and up to 1 friendly non-reinforced, non-HERO INFANTRY unit that have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s passengers. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THIS IS YOUR STOP, MAGGOTS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit’s passengers to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets’ melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 10 to the target’s control score.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

abilities.name: WHAT’S YOURS IS MINE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target. Then, pick an artefact of power the target has.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is in combat with the target. On a 6+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

abilities.name: SWOOP IN
abilities.declare: Pick the Grundstok Gunhauler in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is studying the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up the Grundstok Gunhauler on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units that have an artefact of power and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 3" of the Grundstok Gunhauler and more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: AN EYE FOR LOOT
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve studying the battlefield. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: LIGHT BOMB RACKS
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have FLY and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: AETHERSHOT OVERWATCH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: LONG-LINE SLINGS
abilities.effect: When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.

abilities.name: TRANSPORT CAPACITY
abilities.effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

warscrolls.name: Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: COMBAT ENGINEERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Endrinriggers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have Crit (2 Hits).

abilities.name: MOBILE REPAIRS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKYVESSEL or Zontari Endrin Dock within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, Heal (3) the target.

abilities.name: TIMED CHARGES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: THE HORNS HIT HOME
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is preparing a flank attack to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: WE’LL BE THERE - IF THE PAY’S RIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve preparing a flank attack. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: RAVENOUS COUNTER-ATTACK
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: SHOCK AND GORE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

abilities.name: GLUTTHORN STAMPEDE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is INFANTRY. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves is 5.

abilities.name: PITILESS WARLORD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for an OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability for an OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSNARE SHACKLES
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MAELSTROM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Maelstrom on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Malevolent Maelstrom wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON SUFFOCATING GRAVETIDE
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON PURPLE SUN OF SHYISH
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: TRAVEL THE NIDUS PATHS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of a Nidus Path to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units.
When the underdog uses this ability, they can choose to set up the target wholly within 12" of any Nidus Path and more than 9" from all enemy units instead of the linked Nidus Path in the opposite corner of the battlefield.

abilities.name: ESCAPE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of the escape point in enemy territory to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective and the unit using this ability from the battlefield. That unit has escaped.

abilities.name: GRAB THE REALMSTONE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an objective it is contesting, that you control and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target objective from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of the unit using this ability and not on a terrain feature.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of the Mother Cauldron to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 1, the Mother Cauldron is destroyed. On a 2+, the target is destroyed.

abilities.name: SECURE NEW GROUND
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they contest an objective that you do not control.

abilities.name: RESERVE CONTINGENT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in the second turn force or the third turn force that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: ARRIVAL OF RESERVES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in reserve.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere wholly within friendly territory more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BACKBONE OF SUCCESS
abilities.effect: While a non-HERO unit is contesting an objective, HEROES contesting that objective have a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: SEISMIC SHIFT
abilities.effect: Remove 1 objective from the battlefield.

abilities.name: TOP OF THE FOOD CHAIN
abilities.declare: Pick 3 friendly units to bе the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target has the PREDATOR keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: THE RITUAL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Gain D6 ritual points if you control the Ritual Site.
Gain D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository you control.
Lose D3 ritual points for each Arcane Repository that you do not control.

abilities.name: SLAIN ON THE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy HERO that is contesting an objective is slain by a combat attack made by a friendly HERO, add the Control characteristic of that slain HERO to the control score of that friendly HERO for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: UNITED IN DARKNESS
abilities.effect: While there is at least 1 friendly WARRIORS OF CHAOS HERO and 1 other friendly DAEMON HERO or DARKOATH HERO on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly SLAVES TO DARKNESS units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

abilities.name: A QUEST WELL DONE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If the enemy ENEMY OF THE EVERCHOSEN unit is destroyed by a unit in this Regiment of Renown, add 10 to the control score of each unit in this Regiment of Renown for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: A DELUDED QUEST
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the ENEMY OF THE EVERCHOSEN keyword.

abilities.name: VICTORY FEAST
abilities.effect:
If any models were slain by this unit this turn:
Heal (D6) this unit.
If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.
If this unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: BEAST
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: PREDATOR KNIGHTS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a RETREAT ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that RETREAT ability.

abilities.name: DEMANDS OF THE DARK GODS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
Demand of Khorne: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS units.
Demand of Tzeentch: Pick 1 visible enemy unit within 9" of a friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS unit that is not in combat and roll a D6. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
Demand of Nurgle: Heal (D3) each friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS unit. Then pick a friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS unit that healed any damage points this turn. Until the start of the next battle round, that unit has WARD (6+).
Demand of Slaanesh: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS units until the start of the next battle round.

abilities.name: KNIGHTS OF THE FIRST CIRCLE
abilities.declare: If there are more friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS unit that has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the Ruinous Skies. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: DESCENT FROM RUINOUS SKIES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SWORDS OF CHAOS unit that is in the Ruinous Skies.
abilities.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THE BLACKSTORM APOSTATES
abilities.effect: Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

abilities.name: THE HOUNDS APOCALYPTUS
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within enemy territory, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

abilities.name: THE GRIMROOT ORDER
abilities.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.

abilities.name: BETRAYERS OF THE ANVILKING
abilities.effect: This unit has WARD (6+).

abilities.name: TAMERS OF HARADH’S TORMENT
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: LURKING THREAT
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown if none of those units have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve lurking in the mists. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: THE MISTS PART
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown if they are lurking in the mists.
abilities.effect: Set up the Shardspeaker of Slaanesh in this Regiment of Renown on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the Blissbarb Archers unit in this Regiment of Renown on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that Shardspeaker of Slaanesh, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscrolls.name: Shardspeaker of Slaanesh
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Dark Egotist.

abilities.name: BARGAIN WITH THE MIST-DAEMONS
abilities.timing: Once per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 2 mortal damage on this unit. On a 3+, add 2 to the casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit

abilities.name: TRUTHS OF THE TWISTED MIRROR
abilities.declare: If this unit is a PARAGON, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

abilities.name: THE THRILL OF COMBAT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat and they also have Crit (Auto-wound) for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: BLISSBREW HOMONCULUS
abilities.effect:
This unit’s Blissbrew Homonculi are tokens. There is 1 Blissbrew Homonculus for every 10 models in this unit.
This unit has WARD (6+) while it has any Blissbrew Homonculi. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s Blissbrew Homonculi from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).

abilities.name: ARCANE CHARGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a Place of Power you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the primary objective to the target. If that line crosses any secondary objectives, the first secondary objective that the line crosses is now the primary objective and all other objectives are now secondary objectives.

abilities.name: BRAND OF UNBREAKABLE BONDS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: SPARKS OF PROFANE POTENTIAL
abilities.effect:
If the Magister in the Regiment of Renown has been deployed, set up one of the following MANIFESTATIONS within 1" of them:
1 Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
1 Tome of Eyes
1 Daemonic Simulacrum

abilities.name: BOLT OF TZEENTCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Magister in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: FLICKERING WYRDFLAME
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points inflicted on it this turn by WYRDFLAME SPELL abilities or attacks made with weapons that have the WYRDFLAME weapon ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SKILLED SUMMONER
abilities.declare:
Pick the Magister in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick 1 of the MANIFESTATIONS from the list below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6:
1 Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
1 Tome of Eyes
1 Daemonic Simulacrum
abilities.effect: If there is already a friendly MANIFESTATION from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished. Then, set up the MANIFESTATION you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that MANIFESTATION is a Daemonic Simulacrum, it must also be set up more than 9" away from all enemy units.

abilities.name: JAWS OF FATE
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Snapping Jaws for each fate point you have.

warscrolls.name: Magister
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Arcanite Cabalist.

abilities.name: IMBUED WITH ARCANE FIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly ARCANITE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: SPELLMASTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.effect:
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.
If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound

abilities.name: RADIANT TRANSMOGRIFICATION
abilities.declare: This MANIFESTATION must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this MANIFESTATION to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
1: No effect.
2-3: Heal (D3) each friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
4: Friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH targets can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use RUN abilities.
5: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
6: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.

abilities.name: COMPENDIUM OF DARK KNOWLEDGE
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
abilities.effect:
The target can immediately use a SPELL ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.
Designer’s Note: That spell does not count towards the number of SPELL or BANISH abilities the target can use this phase.

abilities.name: LUNATIC DEMISE
abilities.effect:
Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects:
Split: Pick a visible friendly Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain Blue Horror models to that unit.
Petty Vengeance: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: SIMMERING RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Gain a number of rage dice equal to your fury level. At the end of the battle round, any unspent rage dice are lost.

abilities.name: RAISING THE HEAT
abilities.effect: If you are the attacker, set your fury level to 1. If you are the defender, set your fury level to 2.

abilities.name: ERUPTION OF FURY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 rage dice.
Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of rage dice you spent.
Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:
Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.
Your opponent must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
Designer’s Note: Rage dice do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3 rage dice to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.

abilities.name: FIGHT THROUGH THE PAIN
abilities.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of rage dice. For each rage dice spent, reduce your fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

abilities.name: DEVASTATING COLLAPSE
abilities.effect: When the unit in this Regiment of Renown is destroyed, before removing it from play, you and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, inflict 3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range.

abilities.name: JUMP UP AND DOWN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If the unit in this Regiment of Renown charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. Add 1 to each roll if the target is contesting an objective you do not control. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any of the rolls were an unmodified 1, resolve the effect of the Devastating Collapse’ ability as if the unit in this Regiment of Renown had been destroyed (it is neither destroyed nor removed from play).

abilities.name: BET YOU CAN’T...
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Mancrusher Gargant on the battlefield to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
...Kill the Big Eads: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while they are in combat with any enemy HEROES or MONSTERS.
...Get There Before Me!: Up to 3 of the targets can each use the Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
...Grab That!: Add 5 to each target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: EXCITABLE FOLLOWERS
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT HERO, this unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ALL-CONSUMING SEARCH
abilities.declare: Pick the Ashen Elder in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability. Then, pick an objective or Place of Power that they are contesting and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this battle to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 5+, give this unit 1 ritual point.

abilities.name: DIRGE OF DESOLATION
abilities.declare: Pick the Ashen Elder in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting the target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick another terrain feature to be a second target.

abilities.name: DAEMONIC STRENGTH
abilities.effect:
For each daemonic power point this unit has:
Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.

abilities.name: ENGINE OF DOMINATION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy HEROES, it can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the phase and can only be picked to use a second FIGHT ability if it is still in combat with any enemy HEROES.

warscrolls.name: Ashen Elder
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Hashutite Commander.

abilities.name: EXTRACT POWER
abilities.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, a Place of Power, or a terrain feature and that objective, Place of Power or terrain feature has a friendly desolation token, give this unit 1 ritual point.

abilities.name: STOKED FANATICISM
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly non-HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT unit each phase while it is wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each daemonic power point this unit has.

abilities.name: EARTH-SHAKING STOMP
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy INFANTRY and CAVALRY units while they are in combat with the unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: TITANIC STRIDE
abilities.effect: The unit in this Regiment of Renown can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the unit in this Regiment of Renown by RETREAT abilities.

warscrolls.name: Warstomper Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: DON’T STOMP THOSE, STOMP THEM!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly BIG or LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: ALMIGHTIER STOMPIN’
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D3. For the rest of the turn, add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Almighty Stomp, but all of this unit’s attacks made with that weapon must target the target unit.
If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: TITANIC BOULDERCLUB
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Titanic Boulderclub.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Titanic Boulderclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: THE DREAD BANNER
abilities.effect: While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: FRENZIED VIOLENCE
abilities.declare: Pick the Slaughterpriest in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a visible unit in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target unit has WARD (5+) while every model in that unit is wholly within the combat range of an enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: GLIMPSE THE GOD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be a target.
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by the target’s combat attacks this turn, that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, and no damage points were allocated to that enemy unit this turn by combat attacks made by a friendly unit that is not in this Regiment of Renown, for the rest of the battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s Blood-hungry weapons.

abilities.name: BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD!
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: TRIAL OF SKULLS
abilities.effect: Add 8 to this unit’s control score while it is in combat.

warscrolls.name: Slaughterpriest
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Bloodbound Warmonger.

abilities.name: BLOOD SACRIFICE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
This unit gains 1 ritual point.

abilities.name: SCORN OF SORCERY
abilities.effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: BRAND OF THE UNALIGNED
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it has an Ensorcelled Banner.
abilities.effect:
Remove all of this unit’s Pledge to Chaos keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
PLEDGED TO KHORNE
PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH
PLEDGED TO NURGLE
PLEDGED TO SLAANESH
This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SKRYRE PAYLOADS
abilities.effect: Friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK Doom-Flayers units have WARD (5+) while they are within the combat range of a friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK Stormvermin unit.

abilities.name: FICKLE MOTIVES
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK units while you have more victory points than your opponent.
Subtract 3 from the control scores of friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK units while you have fewer victory points than your opponent.

abilities.name: ALWAYS THREE CLAWSTEPS AHEAD
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly KRITTOK’S CLAWPACK unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use the ’Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscrolls.name: Doom-Flayers
notes: You cannot include more than 1 Skryre War Machine in a regiment led by a non-Skryre Hero.

abilities.name: WHIRLING DOOM
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: FOSTER COMPETITION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly Stormvermin units while they are wholly within 13"of this unit.

abilities.name: DOOMFANG
abilities.effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn but it cannot use commands this phase.

abilities.name: A REPUTATION FOR CUNNING
abilities.effect: You can pick 2 different eligible units to use the ’Always Three Clawsteps Ahead’ ability this phase instead of 1, but at least 1 of those units must have the VERMINUS keyword.

abilities.name: ELITE BODYGUARD
abilities.effect: Friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY HEROES have WARD (5+) while they are within this unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: AELFSKIN SCROLL
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a Wizard within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD within 18" of this unit. After that SPELL ability has been resolved, that friendly WIZARD can use a SPELL ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of SPELL abilities that friendly WIZARD can use this phase.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a Wizard within 18" of this unit

abilities.name: RUNE OF MURDER
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
Add D6 to the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: DARKFLAME PENDANT
abilities.effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.

abilities.name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Emerald Lifeswarm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THE PIPER’S INFECTIOUS MELODIES
abilities.effect: While a Beast of Nurgle in this Regiment of Renown is within 3" of this Regiment of Renown’s Sloppity Bilepiper, it can use the 'Attention Seekers' ability even if the other Beast of Nurgle in this Regiment of Renown has already used it this turn.

abilities.name: BEAST
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: ATTENTION SEEKERS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

warscrolls.name: Sloppity Bilepiper, Herald of Nurgle
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Plague Scion.

abilities.name: JOLLY GUTPIPES
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If you picked a friendly unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
If you picked an enemy unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, until the start of your next turn, while this unit is on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target:
Each time the target ends a move further from this unit than it was at the start of the move, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.
Each time the target is removed from the battlefield and set up again on the battlefield further from this unit than it was before it was removed, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.

abilities.name: SPEW FORTH SIN
abilities.declare: Pick the Contorted Epitome in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.
If you picked a Dreadful Visage or Wheels of Excruciation, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Mesmerising Mirror, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: IRRESISTIBLE LURE
abilities.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a MOVE ability for a unit within 18" of and visible to this MANIFESTATION
abilities.effect: If that enemy unit does not end that move closer to this MANIFESTATION than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the MOVE ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a MOVE ability for a unit within 18" of and visible to this MANIFESTATION

abilities.name: FLENSING TONGUES
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Until this MANIFESTATION is banished or destroyed, the target is tongue-tied while it is within 12" of this MANIFESTATION. While the target is tongue-tied:
It cannot use RUN abilities.
Your opponent must roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target when it uses a RETREAT ability.

abilities.name: EXQUISITE AGONY
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

warscrolls.name: Contorted Epitome
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Slaaneshi Beguiler.

abilities.name: SWALLOW ENERGY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible MANIFESTATION within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.
The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a SUMMON ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

abilities.name: THE MIRROR’S DEPTHS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is gazing into eternity until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is gazing into eternity until the start of your next turn.
While the target is gazing into eternity, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield.
Designer’s Note: This includes pile-in moves.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.effect: If a friendly non-NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non-NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat.

abilities.name: ENDLESS SWARM
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Feculent Gnarlmaw and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BEAST
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: THE BANNER OF RAGE
abilities.effect:
This unit has the PLEDGED TO KHORNE keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

abilities.name: FOG OF DESPAIR
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target units in this Regiment of Renown while they are wholly within 9" of the Harbinger of Decay in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: NAUSEATING CONVALESCENCE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Heal (1) each unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: KNELL OF DOOM
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly Sloven Knights unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: OMENS OF DECAY
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract twice the current battle round number from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, this ability affects all enemy units within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: DISCOMFITING STENCH
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy WIZARD or PRIEST within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice.
If the target is a WIZARD and the roll exceeds the target’s power level, until the start of your next turn, each time a casting roll for the target includes 2 or more rolls of 1, 2 or more rolls of 2 or 2 or more rolls of 3, the spell is miscast.
If the target is a PRIEST and the roll exceeds the target’s power level, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes an unmodified chanting roll of 1 or 2 for the target, the prayer fails, its effect is not resolved and your opponent must remove D3 ritual points from the target. In addition, your opponent cannot give that PRIEST any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: RELENTLESS ATTACKERS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s FLYRIDER’S ARSENAL for attacks that target units contesting an objective.

abilities.name: DISPERSED FORMATION
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: SPLINTERS OF SORCERY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target does not have the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability, it gains that ability for the rest of the battle. If the target has the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability, pick an enemy unit within 12" of it and roll 9 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: BUBBLES OF UNREALITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature with the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time a friendly WIZARD in this Regiment of Renown uses a SUMMON SPELL ability this phase, you can measure the range and visibility of that SPELL ability from the target instead of from the caster.

abilities.name: DRAWN TO MAGIC
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy MANIFESTATION to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.
abilities.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.
Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy MANIFESTATION in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: BEAST

If you are the underdog, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

abilities.name: MAGNIFICENT MONSTROSITY
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).
1
…Da Green Button?: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.
2
…Da Blue Button?: Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.
3
…Da Yellow Button?: Each player gains 1 command point.
4
…Da Orange Button?: Each unit (friendly and enemy) on the battlefield has a Move characteristic of 3D6" for the rest of the turn.
5
…Da Purple Button?: Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.
6
…Da Red Button?: You must immediately use the ‘Clank, Clank, Clank’ ability as if it were the end of your turn.
7+
…Da Whirly Button?: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.
